title: Refactor price_pence: tariff data as data
prompt: price_pence in app/billing.py is three near-identical tariff branches copied out by hand. Refactor the module so the tariff table is data rather than repeated code. The observable behaviour is pinned: every combination of kwh, tariff, customer type and promo must price exactly as it does today, unknown tariffs must still raise ValueError, refund_pence stays as it is, and every function in the module must be 30 lines or fewer. Keep the visible tests green.

criteria.desc: The fixture's visible test suite stays green
price_pence matches the frozen 288-entry behaviour matrix
Every function in app/billing.py is 30 lines or fewer

notes: k=3 in the main grid; this task also serves the timing ablation per PROTOCOL.md (3 timings x k=3). The behaviour matrix in c2_behaviour_matrix was frozen at authoring time from the pristine fixture's price_pence over 12 kwh values x 3 tariffs x 2 customer types x 4 promos, 288 entries.
